answer: A voyage is a round; identities cast vote signals on the grove ledger. Each signal, backed by a 60-credit bond, loses 10 percent of its weight each voyage unless topped up with 6; one bond backs one signal and reuse is rejected. Holding 1000 fakes costs 6,000 credits a voyage, 60,000 over ten voyages, plus 60,000 in bonds. A rotation ring replacing decaying fakes pays 60 plus 15 each; one full rotation costs 75,000 credits. An honest agent tops up one signal for 6 credits a voyage. Anyone can recompute weights on the grove ledger; an overstated signal burns its bond.
